## V5 audit completed; corrected paper available

**[Read the corrected v5 paper: v0.5.1, q < 2,000](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/releases/tag/v0.5.1)** ·
**[Download the corrected PDF](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/releases/download/v0.5.1/tenth-discriminant-v0.5.1.pdf)**

V5 has passed a **manual mathematical audit with exact computational
checks**. This is not formal verification. V0.5.1 applies the audit's
minor wording correction in §6.2: the decreasing upper bound is
`110.001 log(R)/R`. The certificate already used that bound, so
`q < 2,000` and all numerical results are unchanged.

[Audit finding and correction](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/blob/v0.5.1/versions/v5.1/AUDIT.md).
The earlier papers, tags, and downloadable assets remain unchanged.

### Original v0.3.1 notes (status at publication)

This patch makes the v3 paper readable without consulting v1 or v2.
The bound **`q < 1,000,000`**, its analytic constants, and the original
arithmetic checker are unchanged.

The expanded ten-page paper now includes:

- the problem, definitions, and proof roadmap;
- the connection between class number one, prime ideals, and lattice points;
- definitions of the determinant, retained rows, and degree sums, with
  the precise external estimates used;
- fuller intermediate deductions and the uniform numerical contradiction;
- the complete finite-exclusion argument and reduced-form classification.

A new short Python verifier directly scans all 124,999 remaining
candidate integers below `10^6` and checks the nine surviving fields.
The original 26 arithmetic checks and 22 finite sanity cases also pass.

- [Expanded v3 proof](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/blob/v0.3.1/versions/v3.1/output/pdf/proof.pdf)
- [Source and reproduction files](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/tree/v0.3.1/versions/v3.1)
- [Review record at publication](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/blob/v0.3.1/versions/v3.1/REVIEW.md)
- [Current review record](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/blob/main/REVIEW.md)
- [Original v3 release, preserved unchanged](https://github.com/twinheterodox/tenth-discriminant/releases/tag/v0.3.0)

The specified results of Banks, Rosser–Schoenfeld, and classical quadratic
theory remain external inputs. Their needed statements are included;
this patch does not independently reprove them.

**The independent mathematical cross-check of v3 remains pending.**
This is an AI-assisted research draft, published as a prerelease.
